summary: Iteration 2 focused testing of the two new KINTRACK features: (1) SIPP MariaDB connector — configurable via UI, no hardcoded creds; and (2) supporting-document uploads on data entries. Created new pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_sipp_and_documents.py with 21 tests, all PASSED (100%). Coverage: GET /api/sipp/connection shape (no password field exposed), PUT save with super_admin, blank-password preserves existing (has_password stays true), viewer 403 on both GET and PUT and POST test-connection, POST /api/sipp/test-connection graceful 400 with 'Gagal terhubung' on unreachable 127.0.0.1:3399 and last_status→FAILED, sipp.validate_readonly() unit test rejects DELETE/UPDATE/INSERT/DROP/TRUNCATE/CREATE and multi-statement/empty queries while allowing SELECT and WITH, /api/sipp/pull returns 400 for missing mapping ('belum diatur'), 400 for non-SELECT queries, and 400 graceful failure for valid SELECT against unreachable DB. Documents: multipart upload PDF returns storage_path+size+original_filename+is_deleted=false, .exe rejected with 400 'tidak diizinkan', 11MB file rejected 400 'melebihi', GET list returns only non-deleted, GET /api/documents/{id}/download works with Authorization: Bearer AND with ?auth=<token> query param returning PDF bytes+correct content-type, 401 without token, DELETE soft-deletes (list excludes it, download returns 404), viewer 403 on upload and delete. Frontend Playwright: login OK, Sumber Data page shows sipp-connection-status banner ('kintrack_ui@127.0.0.1:3399/sipp_ui_test FAILED') after save, dialog fields (sipp-host/port/database/username/password/save-sipp-connection/sipp-test-in-dialog) all present and functional, password field shows '••• (tersimpan)' placeholder confirming has_password logic, Uji Koneksi triggers backend call and banner updates to FAILED. On Input Data with indicator 1.1 + period selected: pull-sipp-button ('Tarik dari SIPP') renders (SIPP mapping exists with queries), Documents card ('Dokumen Pendukung') renders with upload-document-button and pre-existing document row, file input accepts upload and download/delete buttons render per row.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1008 lines (grew from ~820) — recommend splitting into routers (auth/indicators/data/sipp/documents/dashboard) as it crosses the 700-line threshold.

storage.py uses synchronous `requests` inside async FastAPI handlers (upload_document, download_document). For higher concurrency, consider httpx.AsyncClient or run_in_threadpool. Not a functional bug but a performance smell.

sipp.py FORBIDDEN regex uses \b word-boundaries which is good, but a very cleverly crafted comment-embedded query (e.g. `SELECT 1 /*; drop table x */`) could contain 'drop' inside a comment and be rejected — acceptable false-positive since we're baca-saja. No fix needed, just noting.

GET /api/sipp/connection returns has_password: True but no way to clear a saved password (blank submit always preserves). If super_admin needs to rotate to empty password, current API cannot express that. Low priority.

No DELETE endpoint for /api/sipp/connection — cannot revert to 'not configured' state without direct DB access. Testing environment now has a dummy config 127.0.0.1:3399/sipp_ui_test (kintrack_ui / preserved password from earlier saves). Documented as expected leftover per user's instruction.
Download endpoint accepts ?auth=<token> in query string which will be logged by proxies/access logs. Acceptable for inline browser rendering, but consider short-lived signed URLs long-term.

upload_document does not verify user is the assigned officer for the indicator — any officer/admin/super_admin can upload to any entry. Same for delete (any can_edit user can soft-delete any doc). Not necessarily a bug — depends on business rules — flagging for review.
supporting_documents.download returns HTTP 500 wrapper if storage fetch fails; should probably return 502/503 to distinguish upstream failures.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all new selectors verified: sipp-connection-status, sipp-host/port/database/username/password, save-sipp-connection, sipp-test-in-dialog, sipp-test-button, pull-sipp-button, upload-document-button, document-file-input, download-document-*, delete-document-*)
